note: OpenCut: the zip does not contain the web app. apps/web/ holds only components.json and moon.yml (no package.json, no source), so there is no browser UI to build or put the Port on. apps/api is a Cloudflare Worker and apps/desktop a Rust/GPUI desktop app — neither serves a browser page.
setup: test -f apps/web/package.json || (echo 'apps/web has no package.json or source in the received zip (only components.json, moon.yml)'; ls -la apps/web; exit 1)
